description: Client-side script for analyzing chess positions, managing evaluation process, updating UI, and generating reports in a chess analysis web application.

classes.name: Position
classes.description: Represents a chess position with evaluation data and metadata.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Contains analysis report results including accuracies and classifications.

classes.name: EngineLine
classes.description: Represents a line of engine evaluation with move and score.

classes.name: ParseResponse
classes.description: Response structure from parsing PGN data.

classes.name: ReportResponse
classes.description: Response structure from generating a report.

methods.name: logAnalysisInfo
methods.description: Displays informational messages in the UI.

methods.name: logAnalysisError
methods.description: Displays error messages and resets evaluation state.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Main function to parse PGN, fetch evaluations, and manage evaluation workers.

methods.name: loadReportCards
methods.description: Displays report results and classification counts.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and fetches the final analysis report from the server.
